profile.summary: JLHwung is a Mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in internationalization and localization within the Moment.js library. Their contributions focus on refining locale handling, aligning translations with Unicode CLDR standards, and maintaining build tooling (Rollup.js). While primarily a library-level specialist, their work demonstrates deep knowledge of JavaScript's time/date formatting capabilities and cultural localization nuances. Their PRs show strong attention to detail, community collaboration, and adherence to technical standards, making them a valuable contributor to open-source JavaScript projects.

PR 2: '[locale] Relative seconds i18n' — References Unicode CLDR for relative time unit translations, showing CLDR compliance expertise
PR 3: '[locale] Update bo locale' — Updates Tibetan (bo) locale to align with CLDR v32, proving mastery of cultural localization and Unicode standards
PR 4: '[misc] fix deprecated rollup options' — Fixes Rollup.js 0.53.0 breaking changes, indicating build tooling knowledge and test suite awareness
PR 5: '[locale] zh: align relativeTime.future to CLDR 33' — Aligns Chinese (zh) future tense translations with CLDR 33, showing granular i18n attention
All PRs: Include 'locale approval needed' labels — Indicates collaboration with maintainers and adherence to review processes
PR descriptions: Reference CLDR versions and locale-specific details — Demonstrates research skills and technical precision
